title: Midjourney
tagline: Stunning AI image generation via Discord or the new web interface.
description: Midjourney produces some of the highest-quality AI-generated images available. It runs through Discord (or a new web app) and is driven by text prompts. Its aesthetic leans toward artistic and photorealistic imagery. No free tier—plans start at $10/month for 3.3 hours of GPU time.
metaDescription: Midjourney review: pricing, image quality, pros and cons. Is it worth $10/month in 2025?
pros: Best aesthetic quality of any image AI
